title: kbingest map passes relative PATH entries to mapper children
goal: scrub_env drops every PATH entry that is not absolute and every entry under the worktree, so a child resolving #!/usr/bin/env node or a rustup proxy in the worktree never runs a repository program such as node_modules/.bin/node; a test named kbingest_map_path_absolute_only with a planted relative entry proves it (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F4)
